ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $ \triangle ABC$, $AD$ is the median to side $BC$, $E$ is a point on side $AB$, and a line through point $C$ is drawn parallel to $AB$ intersecting the extension of $ED$ at point $F$. When $AD \perp BC$, $AE=1$, and $CF=2$, what is the length of $AC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:}

Since $AD$ is the median to side $BC$ and $AD\perp BC$,

it follows that $AB=AC$.

Since $CF\parallel AB$,

it follows that $\angle B=\angle DCF$.

In $\triangle BED$ and $\triangle CFD$,

\[
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\angle B=\angle DCF \\
BD=CD \\
\angle BDE=\angle CDF
\end{array}\right.
\]

Therefore, $\triangle BED \cong \triangle CFD$,

which implies that $CF=BE$.

Given $AE=1$ and $CF=2$,

thus $AB=AE+BE=AE+CF=1+2=3$,

which leads to $AC=AB=\boxed{3}$.

Since E lies on AB and AE = 1, E is one unit from A toward B, so E = A + (1/L)(B - A) = (-u/L, v(1 - 1/L)). Because F lies on the extension of ED past D, write F = -kE for some k > 0. E在AB上且AE=1，所以E是从A沿AB方向走1个单位得到的点：E=A+(1/L)(B-A)=(-u/L, v(1-1/L))。

因为F在ED过D后的延长线上，所以可设F=-kE，其中k>0。即F=(ku/L, -kv(1-1/L))。

于是C-F=(u(1-1/L), v(1-1/L))，所以CF的长度为(1-1/L)sqrt(u^2+v^2)=L-1。已知CF=2，所以L-1=2，得到L=3。因为AC=L，所以AC=3。

ready3_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $ \triangle ABC$, $AD$ is the median to side $BC$, $E$ is a point on side $AB$, and a line through point $C$ is drawn parallel to $AB$ intersecting the extension of $ED$ at point $F$. When $AD \perp BC$, $AE=1$, and $CF=2$, what is the length of $AC$?
ready3_open_rewrite.raw_answer:
\textbf{Solution:}

Since $AD$ is the median to side $BC$ and $AD\perp BC$,

it follows that $AB=AC$.

Since $CF\parallel AB$,

it follows that $\angle B=\angle DCF$.

In $\triangle BED$ and $\triangle CFD$,

\[
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\angle B=\angle DCF \\
BD=CD \\
\angle BDE=\angle CDF
\end{array}\right.
\]

Therefore, $\triangle BED \cong \triangle CFD$,

which implies that $CF=BE$.

Given $AE=1$ and $CF=2$,

thus $AB=AE+BE=AE+CF=1+2=3$,

which leads to $AC=AB=\boxed{3}$.
